 Message from the President……


        It is my pleasure to welcome you to Mangaldai Commerce
College, a premier institution for higher learning in the fields of
commerce. Mangaldai Commerce College has had a 43-year great
voyage, crafting thousands of alumni, the majority of them serving
the realm with their brilliant personalities at the national and
international levels.

       The authority upholds a well-structured scholastic and
administrative campus at Mangaldai Commerce College. The college
offers Four-Year Undergraduate Programme (FYUGP) in Commerce
stream in addition to the Higher Secondary (Commerce Stream).
The college also offers courses in B.A. in Assamese, Economics and English; M.A. in Assamese,
English and English; M.Sc. in Mathematics; B.Com & M.Com courses and Master of Business
Administration (MBA) under Krishna Kanta Handique State Open University (KKHSOU).

 From the Principal’s Desk……
Dr. Runumoni Lahkar Das



Dear Prospective Learners,

       It gives me immense pleasure to welcome you to
Mangaldai Commerce College, an institution committed to
academic excellence, value-based education, and holistic
development. Since its inception, the college has been striving to
empower students with knowledge, skills, and ethical values
necessary to meet the challenges of a dynamic world.

       The implementation of the National Education Policy
(NEP) 2020 has ushered in a new paradigm in higher education across Assam. As a single-
stream commerce institution, we have carefully aligned our academic framework with the NEP’s
vision, focusing on flexibility, skill-oriented learning, and multidisciplinary exposure within the
domain of commerce. In response to present-day challenges, our curriculum emphasizes
emerging areas such as digital finance, e-commerce, entrepreneurship, financial literacy,
taxation, and data-driven decision-making. We aim to prepare students not only for traditional
careers in accounting, banking, and business management but also for evolving roles in fintech,
startups, and global markets.

       Mangaldai Commerce College is committed to providing a supportive and intellectually
stimulating environment. Our dedicated faculty members continuously strive to adopt innovative
teaching methods, including experiential learning, case studies, internships, and industry
interaction, in line with NEP guidelines.

       I warmly invite all aspiring students to join us in this journey of learning and growth. Let
us work together to build a strong foundation in commerce education and shape a future of
professionalism, integrity, and excellence.

With best wishes,

                                                                 Dr. Runumoni Lahkar Das,

 PROFILE OF THE COLLEGE:
      Mangaldai Commerce College, a premier institution of commerce
education in the state and the only commerce college in the Darrang district, was
established in the year 1982 by some dedicated and noted educationists. It was
possible only due to the aspiration of the people of Darrang, their help, and
cooperation under the relentless and untiring efforts of a hand of dedicated persons.

      The college's sprawling, scenic, and serene campus spreads over a vast area
on the north fringe of the town, at a distance of nearly 1.5 km from the ASTC Bus
Stand and easily accessible from the town. Situated in a natural setting, the river
Mangaldai on the western side, the campus houses several buildings catering to the
academic needs and support facilities.

      The need for Commerce College was actually felt, keeping in mind the fact
that a large number of students preferring commerce education had to go to the
commerce colleges, which are far away from their places. The Darrang district,
including the surrounding areas of Assam, is developing industrially fast day by
day. As such, the need of the hour was a job-oriented educational institution.
Keeping in view this aspect, with the unlimited efforts of some dedicated people,
the college has come to the present position. Meanwhile, several batches of
students have passed out from this college at both higher secondary and degree
levels with flying colors since its inception. At the higher secondary level, besides
compulsory subjects, optional subjects like economics, financial literacy, and
business mathematics and statistics are offered to the students according to their
aptitude.

   In the degree course, the college is offering majors in accountancy,
management, and banking besides other compulsory and optional subjects of the

SIGNIFICANCE OF THE COLLEGE EMBLEM

        The emblem of college contains a wealth of meaning. On it is
inscribed the name of the college and its motto in three Sanskrit words-
“BANIJYE BASATI LAKHIMI” which means “Wealth through trade”
Le. “Wealth”. The verbal from of “Lakhimi” indicates that the
businessman is the rightful person of the fruits of business and one can get
wealth through trade or business where Commerce education can inspire.

OTHER FACILITIES AVAILABLE:

➢ COLLEGE LIBRARY AND READING ROOM
   The Mangaldai Commerce College Library is located in the ground floor of separate
block which is newly constructed. It is the centre of attraction for both the students and the
teachers. The library operates under guidance of a library committee that meets regularly
and reviews the library functions. Mangaldai Commerce College Library is a modern
computerised library with KOHA software through which all the house-keeping operation
like acquisition cataloguing, circulation, serial control and Online Public Access Catalogue
(OPAC) were done. We preserved college publication, Books, Magazine, Question Papers,
College Prospectus, Ph.D. Thesis, M. Phil dissertations of teachers in our digital library
software (D-SPACE). Through N-LIST consortia and NDLI platform, we provide access
facilities of e-resources to the teachers and students of our college. The library of our
college has been performing various activities from time to time, such as mobile library
services, library visit, library books exhibition and reading facilities for the children of
under privilege people, book donation to different institutions, observed the National
Librarian Day etc. for the benefit of the students, weaker sections and community at large.

Students may borrow books from the library against their Library Cards and also avail the
e-resources of the library. They may read various newspapers and journals in the Reading
Room of the library. There is a book bank facility meant for the poor and needy students.

GRIEVANCES REDRESSAL CELL
The College has a Grievances Redressal Cell in place. The cell is created to redress
grievances of stakeholders relating to college affairs. Grievances are received through drop
boxes, one of which is placed in front of the college library and the other in front of the
Office of the Principal. A student by mentioning his/her name, admission receipt number,
section and class roll number shall record his/her grievances in a A4 size paper and drop it
in any of the drop boxes. Any other stakeholder will record his/her name, address and
contact number along with grievances, if any, and drop the same in any of the boxes. The
Committee formed for the purpose will look into such grievances and do the needful to
redress the grievances.
